description: Submit availability votes (with optional "If Need Be" backup slots and email receipt) for a participant on candidate meeting slots or grid blocks

available_slot_indices.description: Array of 0-indexed candidate slot or grid block indices participant can attend

maybe_slot_indices.description: Optional array of 0-indexed "If Need Be" backup slot indices

send_voter_receipt.description: When true and email is supplied, sends the voter an email copy of their selected availability and poll link

name: submit_participant_vote
